Filing as a Beneficiary of an Immigrant Visa Petition If you are filing as a beneficiary of an immigrant visa petition, you generally must submit a photocopy of Form I-797, Notice of Action, for your underlying visa petition (or the principal applicant's petition, if you are a derivative applicant), as appropriate.
